power: automating power measurements during autotests w/ Sweetberry Add Sweetberry to power autotest automation. I used a "call client test from server test" approach. From power_MeasurementWrapper, the Sweetberry starts to measure power on the DUT, then the client test will run on DUT, then Sweetberry stops measurement. Then power_MeasurementWrapper trims the Sweetberry log generated in the overhead time of the client test, and uploads Sweetberry data generated during actual client test to power dashboard. All assumptions are stated in the control file. BUG=b:68956240 TEST=test_that <ip address of DUT> power_MeasurementWrapper --args 'test:power_LoadTest.very_fast sweetberry_interval:1 sweetberry_config:eve_rev7' (sweetberry_config not necessary) Change-Id: I6681f5638f22f30a09c69ed19e2ccf26503f59d4 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/952577 Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Tested-by: Mengqi Guo <mqg@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Todd Broch <tbroch@chromium.org>

BUG=b:74336712 BRANCH=eve TEST=manual: force update to fail and ensure it goes to recovery mode, and after successful update check that the option rom flag is cleared before the EC reset happens. cryptohome: refactor mount-encrypted error reporting Switch from booleans/ints for returning status from internal functions to an enum of result codes to allow future extension of the set of distinct error types. This unifies the style of reporting errors across mount-encrypted: before the change some functions were using 0 for success, amnd some weer using 1. The new result codes are also returned from mount-encrypted executable as exit codes to allow the callers implement different reactions to different types of errors. This CL doesn't change any functionality or add new types of errors. In one case, an impossible branch - a check if the result was success after we have already checked that it was an error - is eliminated to slightly simplify the code. BUG=chromium:702724 TEST=build, boot Change-Id: If465fa65c99c61f99e3b1b0bbf9d90af6b1507fa Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/972340 Commit-Ready: Andrey Pronin <apronin@chromium.org> Tested-by: Andrey Pronin <apronin@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mattias Nissler <mnissler@chromium.org>
